result.keyword: What's the best payroll software for a small business?
result.markdown:
The best payroll software for a small business depends on how many employees you have, whether you pay yourself a salary, and how much of the payroll administration you want automated.

**My recommendation is to choose a payroll system that automatically calculates tax and National Insurance, handles PAYE submissions to HMRC, produces payslips and manages workplace pension contributions.**

If your business is based in the UK, I'd prioritise UK-specific payroll software rather than US products such as Gusto or OnPay.

## Best payroll software in the UK (2026)

Here are the five I'd shortlist\:

![Sage Payroll](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/YilOgYs9ZP1wfwRzJkFxhA_BlX-p_5FLJTmLkaXii1Zq8iZVEoUFx_wBfKoiVfr0ATGd3JsvVUZhJ3dfKZOkGYm_SBzjjNOitZcJhhfq0Ikj-wTCq4Ucb9ThPMpreJ_oVOHjuM4KTvvryzuP8dhTVsVMgw7AVYaGKaHDYZzKiFaOrf3CUXwlR8gKxA64DoWs?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Sage Payroll**

(Best overall)

- Cloud-based payroll.
- HMRC submissions and pension auto-enrolment.
- Good for growing small businesses.
- Indicative price: £12/month for five employees.
  
  [Sage comparison and review](https://smallbusiness.co.uk/compare-payroll-software-for-uk-small-businesses-2603489/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![BrightPay Standard + Connect to BrightPay Cloud FAQs](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/w4enxIyDycO7AUK2q9MSigbCrvpztFs7Z_H6w-w2lUCrViF19Xl4mmIDmq49uY9OqMEZyacb1cfZ96kB1itVQG4Um52YB5FfIcdxh61NUZmjo-ZiQQw-o3a64YCd83vlmMVrUh7TPEkE6dshtPXZgYIC-gPHTX5mwqy58KHGJgCW85IZxwm6G0figtCehl5s?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. BrightPay**

(Best dedicated payroll)

- Excellent payroll-specific functionality.
- Pension integrations and HMRC reporting.
- Good for businesses with more complicated payroll.
- Cloud pricing by quotation.
  
  [BrightPay review](https://whichpayroll.com/uk/best-payroll-software-small-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![Sage Payroll | CMM Accountancy, Inverness](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/eV7r_Y7LhUUTC9Bu-F6y1eAfhaHXAB2YHguOKgyDONnXgZMuJ-Xf-NJS__sr2531iLivDglNRuay7jZ1VhHl-4B0ijG3RQj1i2keTM8q-3DlUqMCCoO-Ty09j6QnYlQVuoJ4IPeeIA855V7dXW_wjbHTU1JXVKkD4V58gLa3Z_3e4-DGBkjovBT4jhJ0NWAD?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Xero Payroll**

- Best if you already use Xero accounting.
- Payroll integrates with bookkeeping.
- Employee payslips and pension management.
- Payroll pricing from around £1.50 per employee monthly on eligible plans.
  
  [Xero payroll comparison](https://www.workforce.com/uk/buyers-guides/best-payroll-software-in-the-uk-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![QuickBooks Payroll Workshop Coming up at Landmark - Landmark CPAs](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/EpjoKgv3qp1QFtZSwa4jOSAGoy_bpW7Sg9OVIiK8-oa8UMuOdZRCQiQ9wIV6A0EP90E_oKZqlgba5b3V-cBIKwbDpfEpoiDXWBpJxyQbp0PrvFWqMD5tYDybAbqob6mWzYEtZyXdxwg9oLN481huockY4Xh7GxIqIqUTHjoFCNUvsU8P9qXqQ0Z3Uur0cFsF?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. QuickBooks Payroll**

- Best for existing QuickBooks users.
- Payroll and accounting integration.
- HMRC reporting and statutory payroll calculations.
- Around £5 monthly plus £1.50 per employee.
  
  [QuickBooks comparison](https://gosmallbusiness.co.uk/best-payroll-software-for-small-businesses-in-the-uk/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![Moneysoft Payroll Manager - Pricing, Features, and Details in 2026](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/lbqpFgEfGsirMSLuSJ1GKoxdHC_EAa6hePps9KHTIp9IC3qFh1g6j-_VvLxjo-3XkfBPXL74Xt04AGZ0nrj-MQEvVwhGqObFWxbJFwRuAVl-rpH1T18V_OuqJFoR9XB_RzskKHeH287mqsw0QpII4DGhSJVkJZLnDijT3PgVmOaKtVdflPois1xwRsUYPkyh?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Moneysoft Payroll Manager**

- Excellent budget-conscious option.
- Straightforward payroll processing.
- Annual licence around £95 plus VAT for up to 20 employees.
- Windows-based rather than cloud-first.
  
  [Moneysoft comparison](https://velotouch.com/best-payroll-software-for-uk-small-businesses/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Pricing is indicative and should be checked before purchasing. ## Which would I choose?

For most small UK businesses, I'd start by comparing Sage and BrightPay.

- Choose Sage for an accessible all-round cloud solution.
- Choose BrightPay if payroll functionality is your main priority.
- Choose Xero if you already use Xero for accounts.
- Choose Moneysoft if keeping costs down is important.

## Let me narrow it down to the best one for your business

There are four things I'd like to know\:

**1\. How many employees do you have?**
